verdict.rationale: Insomnia Cloud mock servers can be created directly from OpenAPI definitions, prompts, or live URL responses, auto-scaffolding routes/responses so consumers can build against the API before it's complete, and dynamic mocking supports realistic templated/fake data responses. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of mock server reliability and no evidence of generating mocks directly from saved request 'examples' (only prompt/spec/URL inputs documented).
